_optionalServers._comment: Optional local servers — NOT enabled by default and NOT loaded from this block. backpack-trading is a local, user-side-signing Backpack trading server (testnet by default, master switch off, user-set caps required). To enable it, copy its entry into mcpServers and read servers/backpack-trading/README.md first. Never put API keys or seeds in this file — the server reads them from its own environment.
